newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Visa card sales volume up 21 pct yr/yr in Q3 96.
newsitem.headline: NZ Visa card sales volume up 21 pct yr/yr in Q3 96.

text.p: New Zealand visa card sales volume for the three months to September 1996 was NZ$958 million, a rise of more than 21 percent over the same period in 1995, Visa International said.
For the 12 months to September, volume was up 19 percent at $3.54 billion.

"In New Zealand, Visa's share of overall consumer payments has increased by over 50 percent in the five years between 1991 and 1996 as more people turn to the convenience of using visa cards instead of cash," said Dennis M. Goggin, Visa International's President, Asia-Pacific.
The number of Visa-branded cards on issue in New Zealand stood at 1.36 million at the end of September, up 17 percent on a year earlier.
